subject.title: feat(skills): publish large bundles via staged upload

question: Should skill publishing expose the package-style staged upload URL plus bundleStorageId/bundleUploadTicket multipart contract as the permanent large-bundle publish path?
rationale: This is a new public API and storage-ticket trust boundary; the code can be reviewed mechanically, but long-term protocol acceptance and operational ownership need maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after proof and policy cleanup
options.body: Merge the staged skill upload path once real large-bundle publish proof is posted, the changelog entry is removed, and specs/ captures the upload-ticket invariant.

options.title: Rework the API contract first
options.body: Ask for a different or narrower wire shape if bundleStorageId plus bundleUploadTicket is not the desired public skill publish contract.

options.title: Pause the branch
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers do not want a skill-specific staged upload endpoint now.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof and policy cleanup
recommendation.body: Merge the staged skill upload path once real large-bundle publish proof is posted, the changelog entry is removed, and specs/ captures the upload-ticket invariant.
